cues: The male makes four spermatids, which are remodelled into four sperms by spermiogenesis.
The female makes one ovum and another polar body, and the first polar body may divide too: one ovum and three polar bodies, which soon die.
text: Meiosis two. The male makes four spermatids, which are remodelled into four sperms by spermiogenesis. The female makes one ovum and another polar body, and the first polar body may divide too: one ovum and three polar bodies, which soon die.
